app.title: Pizza 4P's — Back office
apiKeys.revokeMessage: The key stops working immediately; any device using it will need a new key.
locale.label: Language
context.required: Choose the tenant and store in the top bar to continue.
context.tenantRequired: Choose the tenant in the top bar to continue.
context.storeRequired: Choose the store in the top bar to continue.
context.chooseTenantFirst: Choose a tenant to see its stores.
context.noStores: No stores in this tenant yet.
context.loadFailed: Couldn't load the list — try again.
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.failed: The password or code was not accepted.
auth.setup.title: First-time setup
auth.setup.description: Exchange the one-time setup token and a chosen password for the super-admin credential.
auth.setup.scanHint: Import the URI into an authenticator app, or type the secret. It is shown only once.
stores.title: Stores & brands
stores.description: Name, create, and organise this tenant's stores and brands — no ULID needed.
stores.loadHint: Load to see this tenant's stores.
stores.empty: No stores yet. Create one below.
stores.name: Name
wizard.title: New store
wizard.description: Set up a store from zero — details, an API key, and the next steps. No ULID needed.
wizard.step1Hint: Name the store and, optionally, put it under a brand.
wizard.step2Hint: Issue the API key the store's devices use to reach the cloud. It is shown once.
wizard.keyIssued: API key issued — copy it now, it will not be shown again.
wizard.doneHint: Next: activate the store's devices (Activation) and publish its configuration (Configuration).
wizard.configHint: Save this as config.toml on the store server, beside the pos_edge binary (or point POS_EDGE_CONFIG at it). It names which store this box is; the box gets its credentials by activation, not from this file.
reports.title: Reports
reports.description: The daily event rollup for the store in context. Counts only — no revenue or personal data.
reports.empty: No rollup yet for this store.
config.title: Configuration
config.description: Publish a level of the store's configuration tree. The store pulls the new version over its sync channel.
config.loadHint: Load to see the current effective configuration for this store.
config.effectiveEmpty: Nothing has been published to this store yet.
config.noVersionsHint: Published versions of this store's configuration appear here.
config.rollbackConfirmBody: This restores the selected version as a new current version. Nothing in the history is deleted, and the store pulls the restored configuration on its next sync.
config.capabilities.title: Capabilities
config.capabilities.hint: Turn store capabilities on or off, then publish. This merges only these flags into the store's configuration — the rest of the store's config is untouched — and the store applies them on its next sync.
config.capabilities.noChanges: No changes from the store's current profile.
apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Per-tenant keys for the public API. A new token is shown once and cannot be recovered.
apiKeys.tokenOnce: Copy this token now — it is shown only once.
devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Printers and displays a store found on its network, awaiting approval.
devices.empty: No pending proposals for this tenant.
webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: HTTPS endpoints that follow a store's event log. The destination is vetted before it is stored.
webhooks.deleteMessage: This permanently removes the endpoint and stops all delivery to it. This cannot be undone.
webhooks.deleteTypePrompt: Type the endpoint URL to confirm
devices.rejectMessage: Reject this device proposal? This cannot be undone.
stores.archiveMessage: Archive this store? It stops appearing in active lists but is not deleted, and can be restored later.
webhooks.secretOnce: Copy this signing secret now — it is shown only once.
translations.title: Translations
translations.description: The tenant's message catalogue. English is required for every key and is the fallback for the rest.
translations.empty: No translations yet. Add a key below.
translations.missingEn: Every key needs a non-empty English value.
translations.missingOnly: Show only keys with a missing translation
taxRates.title: Tax rates
taxRates.description: The rate each tax class charges on each sales channel. Edit the grid, save, then publish to a store — the store bills these rates.
taxRates.noClassesHint: Create tax classes on the Menu screen first; each becomes a row here.
taxRates.blankHint: A blank cell means the class is not sold on that channel — the store refuses such a sale rather than charging no tax. Rates are in percent.
taxRates.publishNeedsStore: Choose a store above to publish.
activation.title: Activation
activation.description: Issue a one-time code a store device exchanges for its credentials.
activation.loadHint: Load to see this store's devices.
activation.noDevices: No devices yet. Add one below.
activation.deviceRequired: Choose a device to issue a code.
activation.codeOnce: Give this code to the device now — it is shown only once.
catalog.title: Menu
catalog.description: Author this tenant's items, menus and per-channel prices, then publish a menu to the store in context.
catalog.loadHint: Load to see this tenant's items and menus.
catalog.itemsEmpty: No items yet. Create one below.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.taxClassEmpty: No tax classes yet — create one below before adding items.
catalog.taxClassesEmpty: No tax classes yet. Create one below.
catalog.categoriesEmpty: No categories yet. Create one below.
catalog.subcategoriesEmpty: No sub-categories yet. Create one below.
catalog.modifierGroupsHint: A set of choices with a min/max rule, attached to items (a pizza's Size, Extra toppings). A modifier is itself an item. Authoring only for now — the store does not yet apply these; edge support is a later slice.
catalog.modifierGroupsEmpty: No modifier groups yet. Create one below.
catalog.groupRuleInvalid: Min and max must be whole numbers with max ≥ min.
catalog.menusEmpty: No menus yet. Create one below.
catalog.chooseMenuHint: Open a menu above to edit the items in it.
catalog.placementsEmpty: No items placed in this menu yet. Add one below.
catalog.sectionsHint: Sections group a menu's items for authoring — Starters, Mains, Desserts. Authoring only for now: a section organises what you see here and does not yet change what the store is served.
catalog.sectionsEmpty: No sections yet. Add one below to group this menu's items.
catalog.sortInvalid: Sort must be a whole number.
catalog.pricesHint: Leave a channel blank to not sell the item on it. Amounts are in the currency's smallest unit (for VND, whole đồng).
catalog.addPlacement: Add an item to this menu
catalog.priceInvalid: A price must be a whole, non-negative amount.
catalog.publish: Publish a menu to the store
catalog.publishHint: Compiles the menu to a price book and writes it onto the store's configuration. The store pulls it over its sync channel like any other config change.
catalog.publishStoreNone: Choose a store in the top bar first.
catalog.published: Published to the store as version {version}.
layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Lay out each channel's screen — display categories and the item buttons they show. Publish (on the Menu screen) ships this to the store; it changes buttons, never prices.
layout.loadHint: Load to see this tenant's display taxonomy and layout buttons.
layout.buttonsEmpty: No buttons on this channel yet. Add one below.
layout.label: Button label
layout.gridHint: A POS grid slot needs both a column and a row (both zero-based). Leave both blank for a flowing layout (tablet or QR).
layout.gridInvalid: A grid slot needs a whole, non-negative column and row (or leave both blank).
layout.sortInvalid: Order must be a whole number.
layout.categoriesEmpty: No display categories yet. Create one below.
layout.subcategoriesEmpty: No display sub-categories yet. Create one below.
admins.title: Console admins
admins.description: Invite and manage the people who can sign in to this back office.
admins.name: Name
admins.inviteRequired: An email and a name are required.
admins.inviteLinkOnce: Copy this invite link and share it with the invitee. It is shown only once.
admins.suspendMessage: They will no longer be able to sign in. Their history is kept and they can be reactivated later.
admins.revokeMessage: The invite link will stop working. You can send a new invitation at any time.
sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.description: The devices where you are currently signed in to this console.
sessions.revokeMessage: That device will need to sign in again.
sessions.revokeOthersMessage: Every session except this one will be signed out. This device stays signed in.
sessions.cannotRevokeCurrent: This is the session you are using now.
security.title: My security
security.description: Re-enrol your authenticator or generate recovery codes for this account.
security.totpDescription: Confirm your password to rotate your authenticator secret — for a new phone or a lost app.
security.totpScanHint: Import the new URI into your authenticator app, or type the secret. It is shown only once, and your next sign-in uses it.
security.codesDescription: One-time codes to sign in if you lose your authenticator. Each works once. Store them somewhere safe.
security.codesRemaining: {count, plural, =0 {No unused recovery codes} one {# unused recovery code} other {# unused recovery codes}} remaining.
security.codesOnce: Save these codes now. They are shown only once, and generating new ones replaces them.
security.regenMessage: Your existing recovery codes will stop working immediately and be replaced by a new set.
invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.description: Paste the invite token you were given and choose a password to create your admin account.
fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Which stores are online and in sync, and whether the cloud's background workers are keeping up.
fleet.noTasks: No background workers are reporting yet.
fleet.emptyHint: Stores appear here once they are registered for this tenant.
audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Who changed what across the console — every setting, key, and menu edit, newest first.
audit.emptyHint: Console changes appear here as they happen.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Operational conditions the platform is watching — a store offline, a relay backlog, a disabled webhook, an unhealthy projector. Newest activity first.
alerts.emptyHint: Operational conditions appear here as the evaluator detects them.
devices.resolvedHint: Who approved or rejected proposals recently.
people.title: People & access
people.description: A store's staff, their roles, and who works where. The PIN is set here and never shown; changes are audited without the name or PIN.
people.loadHint: Load to see this tenant's employees.
people.name: Name
people.codeNameRequired: A staff code and a name are both required.
people.pinHint: 4–8 digits. The PIN is hashed and never shown again; warn staff not to reuse a PIN.
people.pinInvalid: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits.
people.archiveMessage: They keep their history but can no longer sign in. You can restore them later.
people.publishHint: Publishing compiles this store's people, roles, and assignments into the permission set the store applies. Publish after changing who works here.
people.assignmentsEmpty: Nobody is assigned to this store yet.
people.assignNeedsStore: Choose a store in the top bar to manage its assignments.
people.assignNeedsBoth: Choose both an employee and a role.
people.unassignMessage: This offboards the person from this store. Their record and other stores are unchanged.
floor.title: Floor plan
floor.description: A store's areas and tables, and the printable QR sheet. Lay out the floor here, then publish it to the store. Placement is set by grid column and row; a visual drag editor comes later.
floor.loadHint: Load to see this store's floor.
floor.archiveAreaMessage: The area is hidden from the floor but its tables keep their history. You can restore it later.
floor.needAreaFirst: Add an area first — a table belongs to one.
floor.label: Label
floor.seatsInvalid: Seats must be a whole number of 0 or more.
floor.gridHint: Optional grid slot. Set both a column and a row to place the table, or leave both blank to keep it unplaced.
floor.gridInvalid: Column and row must both be whole numbers of 0 or more, or both blank.
floor.archiveTableMessage: The table is removed from the floor but keeps its history. You can restore it later.
floor.publishHint: Publishing compiles this store's areas and tables — and its kitchen stations and routing — into the floor plan the store applies. Publish after changing the layout.
floor.qrHint: Load the signed QR token for each active table, for a printable sheet. The token binds the table to its store — no personal data — and is the value printed on the guest's QR code.
floor.qrUnavailable: QR minting is not configured on this cloud. Ask an operator to set a table-token secret to enable printable QR codes.
stations.title: Kitchen stations
stations.description: A store's kitchen stations and the rules that route a fired item to one. Each station can name a backup for printer failover, and one station can be the catch-all default. Publish after changing stations or routing.
stations.loadHint: Load to see this store's kitchen stations.
stations.name: Station name
stations.archiveStationMessage: The station stops receiving fired items and any rule pointing to it is dropped on the next publish. You can restore it later.
stations.defaultHint: Items with no matching rule are routed here. Set this on exactly one station.
stations.routingHint: A rule sends a fired item to a station. An item with no rule goes to the catch-all default station.
stations.routingEmpty: No routing rules yet — items go to the default station.
stations.needStationFirst: Add a station first — a rule routes to one.
stations.sortInvalid: Order must be a whole number.
stations.needItemAndStation: Choose both a station and an item.
stations.removeRuleMessage: Items this rule matched will fall back to the default station until you add another rule.
stations.publishHint: Publishing compiles this store's kitchen stations and routing — together with its areas and tables — into the plan the store applies. Publish after changing stations or routing.
